text: Congratulations! Has your partner received a B2 visa, like she has a visa sticker in her passport? Because if she has a visa then she does not need an ETA-IL. Regarding insurance, you can read about different options on our website here - it says it is for B1, but most of them apply to B2 visa holders: https://aic.org.il/health-insurance-for-b1-partner-visa-holders/
